### Web-Server
- TypeScript, Node.js
- GitHub: https://github.com/subham12r/web-server (2026)
- Features: Built a production-grade HTTP/1.1 server from raw TCP sockets in TypeScript. Implements full request/response parsing, keep-alive connection reuse, streaming BodyReader, and explicit socket back-pressure. Demonstrates deep understanding of the networking layer underlying all RESTful API design.
